title: Non-calibration release shadow evaluation required a nonexistent v4 baseline

reproduction.observed: The exact C30 offline worker passed preceding static and package tasks, then Test-MIRControlPlaneShadow passed release 3.2.3 to a calibration-only candidate analyzer whose accepted values were 3.2.2 and 2.5.0.

root_cause.summary: The shadow test treated every later release as a new v4/v5 calibration candidate instead of separating calibration releases from releases inheriting an already accepted target cutover.

regression_propositions: C30 is rejected while global or Factorio 2.1 C24 cutover state is pending
a later Factorio 2.1 release is admitted only by an exact passing unrevoked C24 calibration proof with identical component ABIs
P9 remains a calibration candidate and cannot inherit C24 admission
full inherited shadow admission requires exact protected qualification and exact-candidate seal evidence
verification contexts lock the accepted calibration proof when it exists

closure.proof_required: new immutable C30 context through exact protected qualification inherited shadow admission seal and promotion
